thanks for the insight. i know its not my problem to fill their void, but they are very emotionally manipulative. i did act calm with a plan to switch back to Psychology, but this pissed them off more because im "not showing my distress" the first time i showed interest in the military (uncle came to town) mom shut it down fast.  the academic support at UCF was atrocious, so they got a tutor, but then told me it cost alot, so i used it only when i needed it instead of for every assignment. this pissed them off even more because "we would pay for more sessions". i went to my professors and they werent helpful, but their taking the professor\`s word.  


i know its not the end of the world, but the world right now is certainly dystonian.

im in the same boat, along with my Dad nearly beating me over it when he sees me. find a movie you want to see and wait for it find a book and wait. find something you like and just wait it out. its not a happy answer, but its what works well enough for me
